facts.fact: The Controller and Auditor General reports that bills were issued through the TAUSI revenue system by local government authorities in the year to 30 June 2025 (TZS 1.22 billion of them, from seven LGAs, unpaid), that Kibaha Municipal Council's land revenue is required to be processed in TAUSI, and that the ministry for local government had instructed all LGAs to install TAUSI by 31 March 2023 and stop collecting in the older LGRCIS; the audit covered 184 LGAs and does not say how their offices are connected.

The Controller and Auditor General states that the ministry responsible for regional administration and local government (PMO-RALG) instructed LGAs by letter of 31 January 2023 to install the TAUSI revenue system, introduced its property-management module, and set up the IFTIMIS platform for tracking audit recommendations issued to LGAs, as reported for the financial year ended 30 June 2025.
